title: VFD dangling command symbol closure audit (Gates 5–7)

root_cause.summary: Ethernet VFD_UDT command members (Jog/ClearFaults/ForceKeypadCtrl/MOP*/AccelRate*) are library capability. When flattened to Conveyor-style suffixes (JOG/CLR_FLT/DIR_BIT/LOC_CTRL/MOP_*/ACC_BIT) or left as bare IO_MAP operands, discrete-site generation can emit CP_I/CP_O references without a matching declaration because Motor_Starter_UDT only owns EN/AUX/FLT.

who_creates_the_reference.primary_producer: fortna_autogen IO_MAP CP_I/CP_O emit path (_device_member / _vfd_ms_member fallthrough)
who_creates_the_reference.template_leak_source: tools/libraries/OReilly_Library_v3.L5X ASRS_InBound_Interface VFD_Input/VFD_Output ST maps P1000_VFD:O.Jog := P1000_VFD.VFDOut.Jog (and ClearFaults/Start/Stop) — Ethernet module binding example, not discrete feeder IO_MAP
who_creates_the_reference.vba_excel_path: tools/libraries/vba_extract/RoutinesSupport.bas substitutes PConv_VFD from workbook column — Ethernet VFD_UDT slot; discrete path must keep NO_VFD

classification.aoi_member: library AB_VFD* / VFD_UDT members — capability, not known-site population
classification.template_placeholder: PConv_VFD / P1000_VFD VFD_UDT examples in library; clone_template_for_conveyor correctly forces IO_VFD=NO_VFD for discrete

why_emit_reference_without_declaration: Unknown VFD###_<suffix> not in discrete MS map returned None from _vfd_ms_member
_device_member then fell through to bare Fortna IO_Name (e.g. VFD118_JOG)
IO_MAP emitted XIC/OTE on that bare root without ensuring a controller tag / VFD_UDT / module binding
Gate H forbids auto-BOOL fabrication — so the operand stayed dangling

fix_approach.gate_6_template_leak: Skip IO_MAP emit for ethernet-optional VFD command suffixes unless ethernet_vfd_mode / vfd_binding=ETHERNET_VFD_UDT capability is proven (not site-name whitelist). Never fabricate BOOL.
fix_approach.gate_7_symbol_closure: fortna_symbol_closure.check_symbol_closure hooked after L5X write in fortna_autogen.generate — IO_MAP unknowns and ethernet VFD command leaks FAIL with producer→operand→expected_owner→missing_evidence.

verdict: ROOT_CAUSE_CLOSED_FOR_DISCRETE_PATH — optional command roles gated; symbol closure enforced
